CustomField.description: Routing rule for AC_ReviewQuoteStepJourney. Scores are the Einstein Studio response models scaled 0-100 by the ChannelScores transform and copied by the Data Cloud enrichment: Call_Score__c = probability the lead phones us, SMS_Score__c = probability the lead clicks a text, Email_Score__c = probability the lead opens the first email (logged, email always sent). Thresholds from the first scoring run on 2026-11-03 (4,073 leads): call = 42.3 (top 20% of Call_Score__c), text = 39.8 (top 50% of SMS_Score__c). Re-derive after each retrain. Replace the two numbers after each retrain.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Phone), 'Email Only', IF(Call_Score__c >= 42.3, IF(SMS_Score__c >= 39.8, 'Call + SMS + Email', 'Call + Email'), 'SMS + Email'))
CustomField.label: Predicted Channel
